final: WITH per_item AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), per_town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_item GROUP BY town_city), town_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS cross_town_avg_ratio FROM per_town) SELECT pt.town_city, pt.avg_price, pt.avg_ratio, pt.avg_ratio - ta.cross_town_avg_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM per_town AS pt CROSS JOIN town_avg AS ta WHERE pt.avg_ratio > ta.cross_town_avg_ratio
